name: push-up-close-and-wide-hand
title: Push-Up (Close and Wide Hand)
primer: These are variations on Push Ups, one of the best exercises for muscles of the chest (pectorals), arms (biceps and triceps) and core development. The core muscles are the rectus abdominis and obliques, which support the spine.
steps: For a Close Grip Push Up lie face down on the floor, or a mat, with your feet together curled slightly so you rise on the balls of your feet.
Place your hands close together so your thumbs and index fingers form a triangle on the floor.
Draw your abs in and exhale as you raise your body up until your arms are straight.
Keep your head and neck level with your body (don't look up or down) and don't allow your back to rise or fall.
Inhale as you lower your body back to the ground.
For a Wide Grip Push Up move your hands out to a position slightly wider than your shoulders.
